introduction: Rhode Island Legal Services offers civil legal assistance to eligible residents. Intake reviews whether the organization can help with the particular issue.
description: Rhode Island Legal Services offers civil legal assistance to eligible residents. Intake reviews whether the organization can help with the particular issue.

sections.who: Financial eligibility, the type of legal problem and available resources affect acceptance. An application does not guarantee representation.
sections.get: Help may include legal advice or representation in accepted civil matters. Contact intake promptly when a court deadline is approaching.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Request screening

    Use the application linked at RILS or call 401-274-2652.

  2. State deadlines

    Explain the legal issue and any scheduled court date.

  3. Confirm next steps

    If contacted, verify the application information and ask whether your case is accepted.
sections.after: Keep all deadlines while waiting. Confirm the scope of any assistance directly with the organization.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using RILS intake; RILS contact. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
